data.name: Luzum
data.gender_notes: Luzum is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'luzumah' which means softness, gentleness and kindness. This name is often given to babies born in the spring season, representing new life and growth. The name Luzum carries the meaning “Gentleness, softness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Luzum usually hope their child will grow to embody gentleness, softness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the softness and gentle nature of Allah (swt) and encourages the development of these traits in the child.
data.etymology: Luzum belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentleness, softness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Luzum total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: لوزم
